$comment: WASP tool registry. Declared by ORANGE (operator). GREEN's permission engine reads this as the *default* classification and may escalate risk, never lower it. Single source of truth: do not hardcode risk levels elsewhere.

tools.name: sandbox_status
tools.description: Report whether Docker is available and the current state of the sandbox container and lab network.

tools.name: docker_sandbox
tools.description: Create the isolated Linux sandbox attached to the internal lab network (no internet egress).

tools.name: sandbox_destroy
tools.description: Stop and remove the sandbox container. Does not touch anything outside the lab.

tools.name: sandbox_ping
tools.description: ICMP echo test from inside the sandbox against an allowlisted target.

tools.name: sandbox_dns
tools.description: DNS resolution from inside the sandbox against an allowlisted name (Docker embedded DNS on the lab network).

tools.name: sandbox_interfaces
tools.description: List network interfaces and addresses inside the sandbox.

tools.name: sandbox_routes
tools.description: Show the routing table inside the sandbox.

tools.name: sandbox_http
tools.description: HTTP GET from inside the sandbox to the local lab target.

tools.name: sandbox_port_check
tools.description: TCP connect check from inside the sandbox against an allowlisted host/port pair.

tools.name: sandbox_network_external
tools.description: Attach the sandbox to a Docker network with internet egress. Leaves the isolated lab.
